{{Short description|Stream cypher algorithm}}
{{multiple issues|{{notability|date=October 2021}}{{more citations needed|date=October 2021}}}}
In [[cryptography]], '''SSS''' is a [[stream cipher|stream cypher]] [[algorithm]] developed by [[Gregory G. Rose|Gregory Rose]], [[Philip Hawkes]], [[Michael Paddon]], and [[Miriam Wiggers de Vries]].<ref>{{cite web |author1=Gregory Rose |author2=Philip Hawkes |author3=Michael Paddon |author4=Miriam Wiggers de Vries |author1-link=Gregory G. Rose |title=Primitive Specification for SSS |url=https://www.ecrypt.eu.org/stream/ciphers/sss/sss.pdf |website=www.ecrypt.eu.org |access-date=31 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415033446/https://www.ecrypt.eu.org/stream/ciphers/sss/sss.pdf |archive-date=15 April 2012 |url-status=live}}</ref>{{Primary source inline|date=October 2021}} It includes a [[message authentication code]] feature. It has been submitted to the [[eSTREAM]] Project of the [[eCRYPT]] network. It has not selected for focus nor for consideration during Phase 2; it has been 'archived'.
